q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Chen Yu. I’m fourteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my mum, my dad and my little brother. I really like my maths teacher, Mr Liu, because he explains things clearly and he often tells funny stories. I use my mobile phone every day after school, mostly to message my friends, but I don’t use it in class. I like spring the most, because the weather is warm and the flowers are beautiful. I prefer the afternoon, because I feel more relaxed and I can do sport after school. I like table tennis and swimming – I play table tennis with my dad at weekends. I usually listen to pop music when I do my homework. In the school holidays I visit my grandparents, read books and sometimes go travelling with my family. I’d like to try photography, because I want to take beautiful pictures when I travel.

互动交流：能回应对方、提出和回应建议与观点，推动讨论并努力达成一致
整体表现：能用 B1 水平的语言有效完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都能给出完整句子并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…），使用一般现在时、would like to 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see some people riding mountain bikes in a forest. The man at the front is wearing an orange jacket, black shorts and a helmet, and he’s carrying a big orange backpack. He’s riding a white bike down a path with lots of stones on it. Behind him there are two more cyclists. There are a lot of tall trees and green grass on the hill, and there’s an old tree lying on the ground. The weather looks a bit cloudy, but it isn’t raining. I think they are on a trip in the mountains. Maybe they are friends and they are enjoying an exciting ride together. It looks quite dangerous, so it’s good that they are wearing helmets.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要涵盖人物（在做什么、穿什么）、地点和其他物品，并用 I think / maybe / it looks… 进行合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法表达，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. Old people remember a lot about the past, and she can ask them questions. The internet is quick, but you’re right, some websites aren’t correct, so she should check the information. A museum is a good idea because she can see real old things from her area. I think the guided tour is interesting, but maybe it’s expensive and it’s only about one building. The old maps are useful because she can see how the town has changed. Reading the sign on the statue is easy, but there isn’t much information. In my opinion, talking to an old person is the best, because she can get stories that nobody else has. So shall we choose that one? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每一个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），主动谈到其他方式，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的方式。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I like learning about history at school, because I find stories about the past really interesting. Yes, last year my class went on a trip to the city museum. We saw old pots, clothes and coins from hundreds of years ago. I enjoy watching films about the past, because they help me imagine how people lived. I think it’s very interesting to visit castles, because you can walk where kings and soldiers lived. I think it’s important for young people to learn about the past, because it helps us understand why our world is like it is today, and we can learn from people’s mistakes.
